items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: there is Ken Carr and I. I didn't stop playing. You know, Ken says, Frank, he says, did you know we had a two piece van up here?

ctx.x: . . . . There's a funny thing about your comrades there, your, what the hell do you call them, your Jewish friends. He's playing vibes over there and the guy comes over there with his hand and grabs you and saying, how you doing, Godfrey? And here's the guy playing a chorus on the vibes. He did that the other night. Who the hell was that Levy guy? Yeah, I don't know. Yeah, they go up there, he's playing the tune over there, I don't remember what the tune was, and he's going along there and the guy comes up and he…
That's the trouble I get for booking a three piece job.
